Game Overview

In StickJet Parkour, the core idea is straightforward: soar through treacherous landscapes with a jetpack in StickJet Parkour. Test your reflexes and strategy as you dodge rotating obstacles and collect gold coins. Each thrilling level challenges you to master your flight path and survive an ever-dangerous environment. Will you reach the flag unscathed?
